description.p: Save an app by its port, flip the switch, and share the address. Test your site on your phone, show work to a client, or receive webhooks, all without deploying anything.

Localfly Linux speaks the bore tunnel protocol: your machine opens an outgoing connection to a relay server, which passes visitors through to your localhost. Nothing on your router or firewall changes.

screenshot.caption: The Localfly Linux window with one saved app, live at a bore.pub address

description.p: Tunnel daemon with auto-spawn and idle exit, live status command, QR codes, desktop notifications, relay latency, shell completions and man pages.
Initial Linux release: bore-protocol tunnel engine, CLI, Adwaita window and tray.
